review_scope.method: Independently compared each blind case stem, options and any passage against the indexed 346 historical rows; considered semantic paraphrase, shared scenario/passage, objective-only reuse and numeric changes separately. Private draft/key/label/explanation files were not accessed.

historical_comparison.details: The repeated historical themes identified above are chapter or syllabus objectives only. No new V77 case reuses a historical passage, concrete scenario, distinctive values or answer structure. No historical numeric-only variant was identified. This finding is limited to the 13 frozen files listed with hashes.

within_packet_findings.finding: Substantive within-packet semantic duplicate: customer receipts plus old-machine disposal, same activity-classification ask; changed company wording and options do not create a fresh case.
Substantive within-packet semantic duplicate: identify workforce needs / recruit / select / staff function; wording and surrounding context are paraphrased.
Substantive within-packet duplicate with identical total-utility values (28 after four units; 30 after five) and same fifth-unit marginal-utility computation; wording and option formatting vary.
Substantive within-packet semantic duplicate: ranking bundles without assigning numerical utility is ordinal utility; the phrasing/options differ only.

Material objective overlap within the packet: the third item combines complaint/hearing and relief threads already separately asked by the first two. It is not a cleanly independent fresh objective; the single-choice construction also appears to ask for two distinct rights.

Shared cash-equivalent eligibility objective within the packet. Case 1 applies the maturity test to a deposit; case 18 asks whether a short-term, readily convertible, low-risk investment qualifies. Treat as objective reuse, not a confirmed semantic duplicate.

registration_recommendation: Do not count the current packet as 28 independent fresh cases without resolving the four substantive duplicate pairs and the consumer-rights overlap. Historical freshness review itself found no direct reuse in the 13-file record.
